### Trust, Part Two
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-october-13-2017.html
Passage: Psalm 56:3
Points:
- Every new day brings unpredictable demands and potential crises that spark worry.
- Allowing imaginary dread to dominate drains vital emotional and spiritual energy.
- Overcoming habitual fear requires an intentional decision to trust God.
- True trust means willfully leaning on, depending upon, and relaxing in Him.
- Believers can find rest because God is completely competent and trustworthy.

### Choosing Faith Over Fear Tonight
Author: Greg Grandchamp
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-nightly-prayer/choosing-faith-over-fear-tonight.html
Passage: Psalm 56:3
Points:
- David faced mortal danger in Gath yet chose active reliance on God.
- Modern anxieties about health, finances, and relationships stem from fear of outcomes.
- Persistent fear and growing faith cannot long coexist in the believer's heart.
- Trust matures gradually as believers pray and meditate consistently on Scripture.
- Remembering God's past faithfulness provides assurance in current storms.

### Tears in Heaven (Psalm 56)
Author: Angie Velasquez Thornton
Site: The Gospel Coalition Canada
URL: https://ca.thegospelcoalition.org/columns/femmes-scriptura/tears-in-heaven-psalm-56/
Passage: Psalm 56:1-13
Points:
- God intimately records every hardship and preserves every tear of His children.
- Relentless trials tempt us toward despair, but David chose to praise God's word.
- Trusting in the character and promises of God drives away fear of human hostility.
- Believers find confidence and peace in knowing that God is truly for them.
- Even before visible deliverance arrives, faith prompts preemptive thankfulness and worship.
